title: Classic Beef Lasagna

components.name: meat sauce
steps: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Brown the beef, breaking it up, about 8 minutes.
Add garlic and tomatoes. Simmer 30 minutes. Season.

components.name: cheese filling
steps: Stir together ricotta, egg and Parmesan.

components.name: Assembly
steps: Layer noodles, sauce, filling and mozzarella. Repeat.

notes: Freezes well for up to 3 months.
